+

+    "drop_conf50": (suggestion == y) | (confidence < .50),
+    "drop_p05": true_probability >= .05,
+    "drop_p15": true_probability >= .15,
+    "drop_p30": true_probability >= .30,
+}
+

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Cross-fit a CatBoost model after conservative annotation-noise removal."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import joblib
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+from catboost import CatBoostClassifier
+from sklearn.metrics import f1_score
+from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
+from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+train = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "train.csv")
+test = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "test.csv")
+columns = [c for c in test if c not in {"id", "max_ndvi"}]
+X, T = train[columns], test[columns]
+enc = LabelEncoder().fit(train.label)
+y = enc.transform(train.label)
+base = [joblib.load(ROOT / "artifacts" / f"{n}.joblib")["oof"]
+        for n in ["lgb_raw", "lgb2_raw", "xgb_raw", "cat_raw", "et_raw"]]
+p = np.mean(base, axis=0)
+keep = p[np.arange(len(y)), y] >= .05
+print("keeping", keep.sum(), "of", len(keep))
+cv = StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=2025-04-01)
+oof = np.zeros((len(X), 6)); pred = np.zeros((len(T), 6))
+for fold, (itr, iva) in enumerate(cv.split(X, y)):
+    use = itr[keep[itr]]
+    model = CatBoostClassifier(
+        iterations=750, depth=7, learning_rate=.045, loss_function="MultiClass",
+        auto_class_weights="Balanced", l2_leaf_reg=5, random_seed=600 + fold,
+        random_strength=.5, verbose=False, thread_count=-1)
+    model.fit(X.iloc[use], y[use])
+    oof[iva] = model.predict_proba(X.iloc[iva])

+      "test", np.bincount(pred.argmax(1), minlength=6))
